Modify the relevant source file(s) in your current working directory directly to implement the fix described above. Your edit to the existing file(s) is the submission; do not create any other output file.
seats.text:
I implemented `format()` in `format.ts` with no dependencies, matching the README spec exactly:

- Exact-rounding engine (`decompose`/`roundToDigits`/`sciDigits`) that decomposes doubles into their precise binary mantissa/exponent via `DataView` and does BigInt rational arithmetic, so rounding (including round-half-to-even) is based on the *exact* binary value, not lossy string conversions.
- Separate converters for `d/i`, `x/X/o`, `e/E`, `f/F`, `g/G`, `s`, `c`, and `%%`, each handling flags, width, precision, zero-padding placement, signs, and `#`-prefix rules per the spec.
- Verified against actual C `printf` output (via a local test C program) for widths, flags, precision, hex/octal prefixes, `inf`/`nan`/`-0`, round-to-even edge cases (`0.5`→`0`, `2.675`→`2.67`), `%g` exponent selection/trimming, and bigint arguments — all matched exactly.
